body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 Force Damage and push it 1 unit.

surges.html: Choose any horizontal direction for the push.
On a hit, the target's space becomes difficult terrain until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Strain - Projection
rider.html: If you accepted Strain, keep a pressure point in the target's original space until the start of your next turn; the first enemy voluntarily entering it is Slowed 1 until your next turn.
